title: Lesson 1. Shops and stores
subtitle: Типы магазинов и Present Perfect с for и since

sections.title: 1. Types of shops
sections.text: A {bakery} sells bread and cakes. A {chemist's} sells medicines. A {newsagent's} sells newspapers and magazines. A {pet shop} sells animals and food for them. A {sweet shop} sells sweets, and a {book shop} sells books. A {grocery} (grocery store) sells everyday food. A {supermarket} is a big shop where you take a trolley and choose the goods yourself. A {department store} has many departments, for example clothes and household goods. A {shopping centre} (a {mall}) has many different shops that share one building. Looking at shop windows without buying is called {window-shopping}.

sections.title: 2. For or since?
sections.text: We use the {Present Perfect} with {for} and {since} to say how long a situation has lasted. Form: {have / has} + {Past Participle}. We use {for} with a {period of time}: for {two weeks}, for {three hours}, for {ages}. We use {since} with a {starting point}: since {Christmas}, since {2009}, since {yesterday}, since {11 a.m.}. Examples: I {haven't been} to the shopping mall for {months}. My sister {has had} her guinea pig since {Easter}. I {haven't been} to the pet shop since {September}.

sections.title: 3. Rosie's interview
sections.text: Do you enjoy shopping? — I {enjoy} / don't {mind} / {dislike} it. What shops have you been to? — I've {been to} the bakery and the supermarket. How long is it since you went there? — I {haven't been} there for ages. What did you buy when you went there last time? — I {bought} some bread. What shops are there in your neighbourhood? — There {are} a grocery and a chemist's. What shop did you use to go to? — I {used to} go to a small corner shop. What is your favourite shop? — My {favourite} shop is the book shop.
chain: Do you enjoy…? I enjoy / don't mind / dislike
What shops have you been to? I've been to…
How long since…? I haven't been there for / since…
I bought… / There are… / I used to… / My favourite…
